description: Unofficial Immich companion for bulk people management, merge suggestions, missing-location fixes, potential albums, analytics, and natural-language library search.
author: WisdomSky

tips.before_install: This is a companion app for Immich. Set `IMMICH_URL`, `IMMICH_API_KEY`, and the Immich Postgres credentials in the app settings. If Immich runs in Docker, `host.docker.internal` reaches the host; expose Immich PostgreSQL on the host or adjust `DB_HOST` to reach it.

title: Immich Power Tools
